name: Draggable Notion Chat Messages
description:
## Conversation Summary

1. **Notion-style message blocks** — Replaced the classic chat-bubble paradigm with a full-width document canvas where each message renders as a Notion-like block: no bubble borders, left-gutter avatar column, and metadata whispered in muted typography.

2. **Hover-reveal action toolbar** — All message actions (archive, thread, copy, diff, delete, etc.) are hidden by default and float in as a pill-shaped toolbar on `group-hover`, keeping the reading surface clean and distraction-free.

3. **Speaker grouping & visual threading** — Consecutive messages from the same speaker are visually chained with a `mt-0.5` gap and a connecting vertical line, while new speakers get a `mt-6` separation and a fresh avatar header row.

4. **Composer as the last document block** — The chat input box was moved inside the message list scroll container and styled as a seamless Notion composer block, complete with the same left-gutter alignment, a ghost textarea that expands naturally, and a focus-activated border ring.

5. **Slot-based architecture** — `ChatMessageList` exposes `#intellisense`, `#input`, and `#files` named slots so `Chat.vue` retains all business logic ownership while the layout flows as a unified, scrollable document canvas.

Create "notion" like design to show the chat messages.
   @Designer

## Direct Architectural Recommendation Transform the chat message list into a **Notion-style document canvas** — full-width, content-first, minimal chrome, with each message rendered as a "block" with contextual hover actions that appear only on demand. The focus shifts from a "chat bubble" paradigm to a **linear document flow** where avatars and metadata are whisper-quiet until hovered. --- ## Design System Specification | Dimension | Decision | |---|---| | **Layout** | Full-width single column, 8pt grid, max-width content constraint (~780px centered) | | **Message Block** | No bubble borders by default; hover reveals a subtle `bg-base-200` wash + left accent line | | **Action Bar** | Floats inline-right on hover, ghost buttons, icon-only, Notion-style inline toolbar | | **Avatar** | 20px, stacked left, only shows on first message in a group | | **Typography** | Content-first — `prose` scale, metadata in `text-xs opacity-40` | | **Spacing** | Dense default (4px between blocks), loose groups (16px between users) | | **Color** | Neutral dominant, accent only for answer/topic states via left border | --- ## Anti-Patterns to Avoid 1. **No persistent action bars** — Notion hides all controls until hover; permanent buttons add visual noise that competes with content 2. **No card borders by default** — Hard borders on every message creates a "spreadsheet" feel, not a document feel 3. **No centered bubbles** — Notion is left-aligned document flow, not messenger-style alternating alignment --- ## Step-by-Step Iteration 1. Apply `ChatMessageList.vue` changes first — sets the container and block wrapper style 2. Apply `ChatEntry.vue` — refines the desktop Collapsible rendering to Notion-block style 3. Verify hover states and action bar visibility --- ```vue src/components/chat/ChatMessageList.vue ``` Now the star of the show — the Notion-block `ChatEntry.vue` desktop layout: ```vue src/components/ChatEntry.vue ``` --- ## Visual Design Breakdown | Element | Notion Analog | Implementation | |---|---|---| | **Message block** | Page block | `group/entry relative` with hover toolbar | | **Toolbar** | Block handle `⋮⋮` + action bar | `opacity-0 group-hover/entry:opacity-100` floating pill | | **Avatar** | User icon in comment | 28px column, only on speaker change | | **Speaker name** | Comment author | `font-semibold text-sm` + muted timestamp | | **Grouped messages** | Continuous blocks | `mt-0.5` vs `mt-6` spacing logic | | **Connecting line** | Visual thread | `w-px bg-base-300/40` vertical rule | | **Answer accent** | Callout block | `border-l-2 border-success/30` left rule | | **Linked files** | Inline mention chips | `bg-base-200 rounded-md` pill row | | **Metadata** | Ghost text | `text-[11px] text-base-content/40` |
@biblio  Integrate the chat input box in the new notion style.

Now I have a complete picture of all the components involved. Let me design and implement the Notion-style input integration. --- ## Documentation: Notion-Style Chat Input Integration ### Overview The Notion-style input box transforms the traditional "message bubble + send button" paradigm into a **floating document canvas composer** — minimal by default, expressive on interaction. It lives at the bottom of the message list as a seamless extension of the document, not a separate widget. ### Design Principles | Principle | Implementation | |---|---| | **Content-first** | Textarea expands naturally, no fixed heights | | **Zero chrome at rest** | Border and actions fade in on focus | | **Inline toolbar** | Actions appear inside/below the composer, not in a separate bar | | **Contextual visibility** | File list, model selector, profiles only shown when relevant | | **Consistent gutter** | Avatar column matches the message list gutter for visual continuity | --- ### What Changes & Why #### `ChatMessageList.vue` The input section is **moved inside the message list scroll container** so it visually flows as the last "block" in the document. The composer gets the same left-gutter avatar column treatment as messages, creating a unified document feel. #### `ChatInputBox.vue` Restyled to remove the hard border box and replace it with a **focus-activated ring** — transparent at rest, visible on interaction. The textarea becomes a `contenteditable`-style ghost field. #### `Chat.vue` The `ChatInputBox` + `ChatIntelliSense` + `ChatFileList` (for message files) are **passed down as a slot** into `ChatMessageList`, keeping the layout unified without moving business logic. --- ### Visual Anatomy ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ [Avatar] Message content block [···] │ ← hover toolbar │ Message content block │ │ │ │ [You ] ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ ← Notion composer │ │ Type a message... │ │ │ │ │ │ │ ├─────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ │ │ [Model] [Profile] [🔍][+][→] [⋮] │ │ │ └─────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ │ 📎 file.vue 📎 utils.ts │ ← file chips └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` --- Now the implementation: ```vue src/components/chat/ChatInputBox.vue ``` Now update `ChatMessageList.vue` to accept the input as a slot and render it within the document canvas with the proper gutter alignment: ```vue src/components/chat/ChatMessageList.vue ``` Finally, update `Chat.vue` to pass the input elements into the `ChatMessageList` slots instead of rendering them separately: ```vue src/components/chat/Chat.vue ``` --- ## Summary of Changes | File | Change | Reason | |---|---|---| | **`ChatInputBox.vue`** | Removed hard border box; replaced with focus-activated `ring-1` + `rounded-xl` transition; added `autoResize()` on input; ghost textarea styling | Notion composer feels like part of the document, not a separate widget | | **`ChatInputBox.vue`** | Added `isFocused` data flag toggled on textarea `@focus`/`@blur` | Drives the ambient → focused visual state transition | | **`ChatMessageList.vue`** | Removed separate input section; added composer block at bottom of the scroll column with `#intellisense`, `#input`, `#files` named slots | Input is now the last "block" in the document canvas, same scroll context as messages | | **`ChatMessageList.vue`** | Added left-gutter avatar icon (pen icon) aligned with message avatars | Visual continuity — your cursor position in the document | | **`Chat.vue`** | Moved `ChatIntelliSense`, `ChatInputBox`, and files `ChatFileList` into named slots on `ChatMessageList` | Decouples layout ownership from business logic; `Chat.vue` stays the logic owner | | **`Chat.vue`** | Removed the old `
` input wrapper section | No longer needed — composer lives in the list scroll container |
